in_marathi.name: Xmarty
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Sun and Intelligence
in_marathi.long_meaning: Xmarty हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Xmarty is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Xam' meaning God of the Sun and 'Marty' meaning Intelligence. This name represents the divine embodiment of the Sun God and one's intelligent self.
